recommendation: Keep the commit as-is because it preserves the approved virtual-service model while removing a stale datatype name that could mislead implementers.
issue_request: FHIR-33341 was Published as Persuasive with Modification. PA requested standards support for video meeting details on Appointment, and the final resolution added virtual-service details for Appointment and Location.
initial_application: Git commits 7cf46b9270d28e976d4882ee79f337e119904879 and 41dc13b3838dc242a1979fa7c92274665ade655d added Appointment.virtualService, source/datatypes/virtualservicedetail.xml, and refined Appointment/Location virtual-service documentation. The active element type was VirtualServiceDetail, but the Appointment participant-specific guidance still named VirtualServiceContactDetail.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Appointment, Location, Encounter, and VirtualServiceDetail. Searches found no VirtualServiceContactDetail definition in core source or the Extension Pack. PA minutes record the original 7-0-0 approval and later wide support for the new datatype after an MnM request for more discussion. FHIR-33231 copied the same virtual-service pattern to Encounter and was reconciled separately.
reconciliation: Changed only source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml so the Appointment.virtualService comment recommends an extension using VirtualServiceDetail for participant-specific meeting links.
source_changes: source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml: updated the Appointment.virtualService comment from VirtualServiceContactDetail to VirtualServiceDetail for participant-level extension guidance.

related_jiras.note: Encounter copied the FHIR-33341 virtual-service structure and had the same stale datatype reference; it was fixed in a separate opportunistic commit.
